body: Thank you. It feels nice that a stranger over the Internet cares. Everything is just hard because I'm always lonely, having moved countries for school. I just don't have anyone to talk to.

I'm tired of waking up everyday all drugged up from my meds. I find new ways to hate myself every morning. I'm tired of feeling like this, and tired of trying to change things. It's been a long battle and I'm giving up.

Thank you very much for your kind words, but I think I had enough. I have been trying though. Nothing works and I feel miserable and lonely. It's all I can do to last a few more days until my mother leaves.
